Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 2026

LumiWear respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal data we collect, why, and what your rights are under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

What we collect

  • Orders: your name, email address, phone number (if given), delivery address and the products you order.
  • Messages: your name, email address and the message you send through our contact form.

Why we use it

  • To process, ship and support your order.
  • To answer your questions.

We never use your data for advertising and we never sell it.

Who we share it with

Only the services we need to run the shop: our website host (Netlify, which receives form submissions), our payment provider and our delivery partner.

Cookies and local storage

We don’t use tracking or advertising cookies. Your cart is saved in your own browser so it’s still there when you come back. It stays on your device until you place an order.

How long we keep it

Order data is kept for 5 years, as required by tax law. Messages are deleted after 12 months.

Your rights

You can ask to see, correct or delete your personal data, or object to how we use it, at any time. Send your request through the contact page and we’ll respond within 30 days. You can also file a complaint with your national data protection authority (in Poland: UODO).
